topic: Wake Up, Sun! A Morning Routine Song
title_hi: सूरज दादा जागो! - Chintu & Mithu Morning Song
title_en: Wake Up Sun! - Chintu & Mithu Morning Song
description: Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot wake up the sun in this fun morning routine song for toddlers. Join the joyful dance and start your day with a smile! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #MorningSong
learning: Teaches children about morning routines and the concept of waking up with the sun in a fun, musical way.

scenes.text: Arrey! Suraj dada so rahe hain kya?

Vertical 9:16, Mithu the green parrot with a red cap perched on Chintu's head, both characters pointing at the sun, joyful expressions, high-quality cartoon style, vibrant garden background.

scenes.text: Tap, tap, tap! Chintu dancing fast!
